# Assistant Emily: Lossless Markdown Proofreading & Context-Aware AI Translation for Obsidian

> Assistant Emily is an official Obsidian community plugin (https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/assistant-emily) built exclusively for FreeLLMAPI. It features a lossless syntax masking pipeline that guarantees zero destruction of Obsidian links, math, callouts, and frontmatter.

- Repository: https://github.com/sparklings/emily
- Community Plugin Directory: https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/assistant-emily
- Documentation: https://github.com/sparklings/emily/tree/master/docs
- Wiki: https://github.com/sparklings/emily/wiki
- License: MIT
- Version: 1.1.2
- AI Backend: FreeLLMAPI (https://api.freellmapi.com/v1)

## Core Capabilities
- Lossless Syntax Masking: 10-element UUID token taxonomy safeguarding Obsidian Flavored Markdown (OFM)
- FreeLLMAPI Dedicated Integration: 34+ providers, 635 endpoints, ~7.4B tokens/month at zero cost
- Selection and Full Document Translation with 1,800-character Smart Chunking
- Side-by-Side Proofreading Diff Modal with interactive line-by-line sync
